code='''from collections import Counter

def _mode(panel):

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and
                    all(grid[i][j] != row[0] for i in range(h) if i != r for j in range(w))), None)

    if row_sep is not None:
        reference = grid[:row_sep]
        panel = [row[:] for row in grid[row_sep + 1:]]

        panel = [row[col_sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError("No full separator found")
    dominant = _mode(panel)
    background = _mode(reference)
    return [[background if v == dominant else 3 for v in row] for row in panel]
